plot_hooks.title: Seeking Treasure and Adventure
plot_hooks.summary: The characters are traveling from the Sword Coast into Icewind Dale seeking fortune and adventure.
plot_hooks.how_party_learns: This is presented by the adventure introduction as a primary motive for traveling into Icewind Dale.
plot_hooks.dm_notes: Players may create their own backgrounds and motivations connected to this hook. Encourage the party to discuss what brought them to the cold north.

plot_hooks.title: Driven by Secrets
plot_hooks.summary: Each character has a secret that drives them north into the frozen wilds.
plot_hooks.how_party_learns: Suggested for party background customization at session start.
plot_hooks.dm_notes: Players are encouraged to develop a personal secret that may be revealed or developed during play.

avalanche_survival.title: Trapped in the Avalanche
avalanche_survival.description: The party is caught in an avalanche while traversing a mountain pass north into Icewind Dale and must follow a mysterious muskrat to survive.
avalanche_survival.hook: The avalanche threatens immediate death; following the muskrat reveals a hidden escape route.
avalanche_survival.current_objective: Escape the avalanche by following the muskrat into the fissure.
avalanche_survival.next_milestone: Meet Mother Tusk and her menagerie.

known_to_players: Following the muskrat is the only apparent way to survive. There is urgency to escape the avalanche.
truth_hidden: Mother Tusk orchestrated the muskrat rescue as a way to recruit help for her own cause.

success_conditions: Party escapes the avalanche via the fissure.
failure_conditions: Characters remain in the open and are buried by the avalanche.
avalanche_survival.dm_notes: This thread sets up the basic party connection to Mother Tusk. The avalanche should feel deadly and require urgent action.

rescue_spritzel.title: Rescue Spritzel
rescue_spritzel.description: Mother Tusk asks the party to find and rescue her scout-child, the otter Spritzel, who has gone missing near Easthaven.
rescue_spritzel.hook: Mother Tusk requests the PCs check on her missing otter in exchange for helping them survive.
rescue_spritzel.current_objective: Find Spritzel by following animal tracks along Redwaters’ shore.
rescue_spritzel.next_milestone: Confront the pack of wolves pursuing Spritzel and his otters.

known_to_players: Mother Tusk's otter scout is missing and likely being hunted by wolves nearby.
truth_hidden: One of the wolves is awakened and acts under orders from a corrupted druid seeking Mother Tusk.

success_conditions: Spritzel is saved and safely returned to the encampment.
Party survives the cold and makes it back to Mother Tusk.
failure_conditions: Spritzel is killed or captured by wolves.
rescue_spritzel.dm_notes: Highlight the urgency due to weather, the odd intelligence of the lead wolf (Vundrel), and the role of the awakened druid as a background threat.

curse_everlasting_rime.title: The Everlasting Rime
curse_everlasting_rime.description: Icewind Dale is cursed with unending twilight due to a magical curse from the goddess Auril. Survival is more difficult, and travel is hampered.
curse_everlasting_rime.hook: Party learns gradually from NPCs, strange phenomenon, and the darkness.
curse_everlasting_rime.current_objective: Understand the nature of the curse and its effects on the land.
curse_everlasting_rime.next_milestone: Find evidence or lore connecting Auril directly to the rime.

known_to_players: The land is cursed with permanent twilight and freezing conditions.
truth_hidden: Mother Tusk suspects a divine curse from Auril, and that the awakened druid may be a minion.

success_conditions: Curse's source is understood or revealed.
failure_conditions: Curse persists and hampers survival throughout adventure.
curse_everlasting_rime.dm_notes: This thread is foreshadowed but not directly resolvable in this sample adventure.

spine_world_pass.name: Mountain Pass in the Spine of the World
spine_world_pass.dm_notes: Initial setting for the avalanche event. Travel is dangerous and slow.

mother_tusk_encampment.name: Mother Tusk's Encampment
mother_tusk_encampment.dm_notes: Safe haven for the party between quests; animals are wary of outsiders.

redwaters_shore.name: Redwaters Shore
redwaters_shore.dm_notes: Otters' trail and wolf tracks are found here.

ice_slides_cave.name: Ice Slides Cave
ice_slides_cave.dm_notes: Cave leads to the main encounter with wolves and otters.

icewind_dale_region.name: Icewind Dale
icewind_dale_region.dm_notes: Overall campaign region. Perpetual dim light due to Auril’s curse.

avalanche_fissure_cavern.name: Avalanche Fissure Cavern

description.read_aloud: The icy slide dumps you unceremoniously into a cold cavern. The muskrat stares you in the eye, then wiggles a bit, as if happy to see you survived the close call.
description.summary: A natural cavern beneath the avalanche, room for several people, damp and cold, shadows conceal a menagerie of animals.

skill_challenges.goal: Surviving the fall and avoiding injury.

avalanche_fissure_cavern.dm_notes: Site for meeting Mother Tusk. Use animal voices and shadows to set the scene.

ice_slides_cave_chamber.name: Ice Slides Cave Chamber

description.read_aloud: The ice slides end in a chamber flooded with a foot of frigid water. The otters swim adeptly at the far side of the cavern, avoiding the wolves’ snapping jaws.
description.summary: Main chamber at the bottom of the ice slides, partly submerged, slick icy shelves, home to the climactic wolf-otter battle.

skill_challenges.goal: Navigating the ice slides safely (Dexterity Acrobatics)

ice_slides_cave_chamber.dm_notes: Manage initiative and provide consequences for failed Acrobatics checks and cold survival. Spritzel and the otters can help the party, but are not direct combatants.

boots_of_false_tracks.name: Boots of False Tracks
boots_of_false_tracks.description: Comfortable, fur-lined boots embroidered with gaudy, worthless gems. While wearing them, you may choose to leave tracks like another humanoid of your size.
boots_of_false_tracks.lore: Made for scoundrels and spies, these boots are popular among smugglers.
boots_of_false_tracks.acquisition_method: Looted from a frozen explorer in the ice slides cave.
boots_of_false_tracks.quest_significance: A small aid to future tracking or evasion encounters.
boots_of_false_tracks.dm_notes: Only one pair is found; describe the former owner's remains as a reminder of the land's lethality.

spritzels_pearl_earring.name: Spritzel's Pearl Earring
spritzels_pearl_earring.description: A shiny pearl earring, prized by Spritzel, serving as thanks to the party for saving him.
spritzels_pearl_earring.lore: Spritzel found it on a shoreline and made it his signature accessory.
spritzels_pearl_earring.quest_significance: Token of friendship and gratitude; minor roleplay value.
spritzels_pearl_earring.dm_notes: Present as a nonmagical trophy; Spritzel will remember who keeps it.

mother_tusk.name: Mother Tusk
personality: ruthless if her family is threatened
mother_tusk.appearance: A massive, ten-foot-long walrus with intelligent eyes and a commanding presence.
secrets: The goliath druid who awakened her is still alive, corrupted, and hunting her.
She fears for her family's safety but will not tell the whole truth yet.
mother_tusk.motivation: To keep all her awakened animal charges safe.

knowledge_of_threads.avalanche_survival: Mastermind of the party's rescue; orchestrated their path.
knowledge_of_threads.rescue_spritzel: Trusts the party with her child's life; knows wolves are not normal.
knowledge_of_threads.curse_everlasting_rime: Knows it's divine in origin but withholds details.

information_can_provide: Directions to Spritzel's last known location
mother_tusk.dm_notes: Mother Tusk is planned for future episodes; keep her alive and functional. Roleplay her as wary yet fiercely maternal.

spritzel.name: Spritzel
spritzel.appearance: White-furred otter with a brown patch above the right eye, sporting a pearl earring.
spritzel.voice: High, squeaky voice, speaks rapid Common.
secrets: Doesn't fear danger if it's for a good cause.
spritzel.motivation: To brave danger and find shiny things.

knowledge_of_threads.avalanche_survival: Rescued by party, unaware of bigger schemes.
knowledge_of_threads.rescue_spritzel: Central; knows he was being hunted by an unusually intelligent wolf.

information_can_provide: Description of black-feathered owlbear spotted near Easthaven
Hints of the wolves' unnatural behavior
spritzel.dm_notes: Irrepressible and memorable; rewarding the party with his earring is a strong hook for their continued investment.

vundrel.name: Vundrel
vundrel.appearance: Large, alert wolf with unusual intelligence in her eyes.
secrets: Works for the corrupted goliath druid.
vundrel.motivation: To hunt down Mother Tusk's family as ordered.

knowledge_of_threads.rescue_spritzel: Sees Spritzel as quarry, recognizes party as interference.

information_can_provide: Hints about the druid master and the greater threat

combat_stats.special: Keen Hearing and Smell, Pack Tactics

vundrel.dm_notes: Adjust stats based on party size (dire wolf for strong parties). Vundrel should show unnatural cunning.

muskie.name: Muskie
muskie.appearance: Snowy-white muskrat with alert, darting eyes.

knowledge_of_threads.avalanche_survival: Saves party by leading them into the fissure.

muskie.dm_notes: A plot device for guiding the party; handwave combat stats.

mother_tusks_family.name: Mother Tusk's Family
mother_tusks_family.ideology: Awakened creatures deserve safety from exploitation or manipulation by humanoids.
mother_tusks_family.dm_notes: Unusual, sentient animal kin group. They are wary at first but may become strong allies with further episodes.

party_rescued_by_mother_tusk.effect: Party is saved and indebted to Mother Tusk.
party_rescued_by_mother_tusk.potential_payoff: Leads to party meeting Mother Tusk and becoming involved in her troubles.
party_rescued_by_mother_tusk.dm_notes: This is the branching point for all subsequent episodes.

spritzel_rescued_or_lost.effect: Spritzel is either saved (party receives reward, builds trust) or lost (Mother Tusk withdraws trust and missions).
spritzel_rescued_or_lost.potential_payoff: Spritzel surviving enables future adventure aid.
spritzel_rescued_or_lost.dm_notes: Determine outcome based on party actions; Spritzel should survive unless party fails drastically.

darkness_level.description: Represents the prevailing lack of sunlight in Icewind Dale (0 = bright daylight, 10 = perpetual darkness).
darkness_level.changes_when: Auril's curse is strengthened or weakened.

party_cold_exposure.description: Tracks cumulative cold exposure on current mission.
party_cold_exposure.changes_when: Party spends 30 min in freezing weather without warmth.

avalanche_imminence.description: Time before avalanche hits party in the pass
avalanche_imminence.on_expire: Avalanche buries the party, causing near-certain death

exposure_limit.description: Cold exposure limit before party suffers exhaustion
exposure_limit.ticks_when: Party is wet or without heat after cave encounter
exposure_limit.on_expire: Party members must make saves or gain levels of exhaustion

trigger_conditions: Party is traveling through the Spine of the World pass
avalanche_event.description: An avalanche descends rapidly, threatening to bury everything in the pass.
avalanche_event.dm_notes: Not a combat encounter, but a skill challenge to escape. Do not use initiative; use urgency and rapid description.

trigger_conditions: Party enters the cave chamber at bottom of slides
Spritzel and otters are present, wolves in pursuit
wolf_pack_chase.description: Pack of four wolves, led by awakened wolf Vundrel (or dire wolf for strong parties), attacks otters and PCs.
wolf_pack_chase.dm_notes: Adjust number and strength of wolves per party strength. Use otter swarming to help party. The lead wolf speaks and is the key threat.

agree_to_help_mother_tusk.condition: Party agrees to take on a mission for Mother Tusk
agree_to_help_mother_tusk.new_objective: Complete the chosen rescue or errand for Mother Tusk
agree_to_help_mother_tusk.narrative_impact: Party is trusted with more secrets, access to further help, healing, and information
agree_to_help_mother_tusk.dm_notes: This is a natural branch; refusing aid would cut short the adventure for that character.

spritzel_saved.condition: Party saves Spritzel from wolves and freezing
spritzel_saved.new_objective: Return to Mother Tusk for reward and rest
spritzel_saved.narrative_impact: Spritzel becomes an ally, party benefits from healing and loot.
spritzel_saved.dm_notes: Reinforces party's standing with awakened animal faction.

spritzel_lost.condition: Party fails or refuses to save Spritzel
spritzel_lost.new_objective: Confront Mother Tusk with the outcome
spritzel_lost.narrative_impact: Mother Tusk withdraws trust and future aid; adventure may end early for that PC.
spritzel_lost.dm_notes: This should only occur on extreme party failure or intentional cruelty.

Garrick.name: Garrick Almsford
Garrick.appearance: Tall, square framed blonde long bearded human with chainmail, longsword and shield with striking blue eyes.
Garrick.personality: Faith is the axis around which his life turns. He doesn't waver easily, even under pressure.
Garrick.backstory: Born to humble clergy and raised to defend the helpless.
Garrick.notes: Lies make him physically uncomfortable; He speaks truths plainly, sometimes too bluntly.

Puss.name: Puss N. Boots
Puss.appearance: Small stature orange tabi with large ears, green eyes a soft white under belly. Wearing studded leather armor, boots a fancy belt and a fancy turqoius pirate hat with a peacock feather.
Puss.personality: Self described charming. Arrogant and overconfident.
Puss.backstory: As a kitten he was thrown into a river in a sock. He managed to escape and spent most of his life on the streets. Where he was taken in by a swordmaster. He learned mastery afrom the swordmaster and started adventuring when the swordmaster died.
Puss.notes: Prefers one sided solutions; often tries to pursuade NPCs with deciet or persuasion.

Tiktik.name: Tiktik Spellfeather
Tiktik.appearance: Medium sized raven with robes and side pack.
Tiktik.backstory: A traveling wizard whose aspirations lend towards necromancy and darkness.
Tiktik.notes: Prefers fatal solutions; often tries to instigate NPCs with words.

Juna.name: Juna
Juna.appearance: Tall tan skinned, purple eyes with breeches, wearing a great axe and two hand axes.
Juna.personality: Young naive and quick to anger.
Juna.backstory: Lived in a forest for most of her life, isolated from society gaining favor with a local barbarian tribe.
Juna.notes: Prefers being up front and in the fray; often tries to intimidate NPCs with a show of strength.

messages.content:
The characters present in the party are:

- Garrick Almsford: Human Paladin, tall with long blonde beard, carries chainmail, shield, longsword; known for plain truth-telling and faithfulness.

- Puss N. Boots: Male Tabaxi Rogue, small orange feline wearing studded leather armor, a fancy turquoise pirate hat with peacock feather; self-described charming and overconfident street survivor.

- Tiktik Spellfeather: Female Kenku Wizard, a dark-feathered raven robed and carrying a side pack; brooding and cynical with necromantic leanings.

- Juna: Female Wood-Elf Barbarian, tall tan-skinned with purple eyes, wields a great axe and two hand axes; young, naive, quick-tempered, favors direct confrontation.

The players' characters are:

- Garrick Almsford, Human Paladin
- Puss N. Boots, Male Tabaxi Rogue
- Tiktik Spellfeather, Female Kenku Wizard
- Juna, Female Wood-Elf Barbarian

Garrick Almsford is a tall human male with a square frame and striking blue eyes. His long blonde beard complements his chainmail armor, and he carries both a longsword and a shield. Known for his unwavering faith, Garrick speaks plainly and truthfully, sometimes to a blunt degree. Born to humble clergy and raised to defend the helpless, his life is centered around his steadfast devotion.

Juna is a tall Wood-Elf female with tan skin and striking purple eyes. She wears breeches and wields a great axe along with two hand axes. Young and somewhat naive, she is quick to anger and prefers to be up front in any confrontation, often using her strength to intimidate others. Her background is as an outlander, having lived most of her life isolated in a forest and gaining favor with a local barbarian tribe.

A biting wind howls through the narrow mountain pass known as the Spine of the World. Snow swirls thickly, blotting out distant peaks and transforming the trail into a slippery gauntlet edged by jagged ice formations. Above, a low gray sky threatens more snowfall, and the faint rumble of shifting snow echoes ominously from the slopes. The cold seeps into bone, while shadows flicker as shapes dart just out of focus on the edges — the silent watchers of the frozen wilderness.

Suddenly, a small white muskrat bursts from the snowbank, darting toward you with frantic urgency. Its bright eyes lock on yours as the distant thunder of a gathering avalanche grows louder, shaking loose snow and ice along the narrow pass. Survival demands swift action: follow the muskrat into the hidden fissure before the mountain claims all in its deadly collapse.
